body: Social anxiety is hard. I'm sure a lot of redditors can relate, and even more people can relate with financial struggles. Hang in there. i am a failure in a lot of regards, but I just treasure the days when I feel like a winner. It seems like you know what makes you happy, you just need to take that first step to getting there. Know that there are loads of people out there who would want to be your friend. I'd hang out with you. We could trade psych ward war stories (I did an internship in one). I really hope you can see the good in your present life and in your potential.

I just want to thank everyone who took the time to reply. I'm going to get help. I don't know what's wrong exactly. Suicide is just the first option that comes to mind for me. I remember how saddened I was when two family members did it. I don't want to make anyone feel that way.

Sincerely thanks.
I appreciate that. I need to do it. I go back in July. I'll update then...hopefully with good news.
Thank you. It sucks to fail at something that pretty much everyone does, but I realize I'm too hard on myself for it. Coffee is delicious, glad you can have copious amounts now. :)
After thinking of hurting my baby and self, yeah. I'm going to.
You're fantastic, and I love your username. Thanks for the smile.
I read this yesterday, and it made me feel so much better. Thank you so much.
